'''TriPlanetary Press''' was a publishing firm located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It printed some notable [[Book/Legends|books]], including ''[[Encyclopedia Galactica]]'', ''[[Gunray On Top]]'', and ''[[Holding Back the Tide]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and ''[[Minds and Perceptions: A Comparative Study of Persuasive Techniques During the Galactic Civil War]]'' after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was also the publisher of [[Rogar Farnoster]]'s famous book ''[[The Slug Named Grendel]]''.
